notes.title: Website Maintenance
notes.notes:
For those wondering where our website went, we're going to be down for a bit while we move servers and do some long overdue updates. If you need support you can still reach us at help@longbowgames.com and check social media for updates on the new DX-Ball 2 and Hegemony III content that is in the works.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/fce1e5f03a8c146ba76869663ee2a353c9fbf804.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New DX-Ball 2 Beta Out Now!
notes.notes:
The new DX-Ball 2 beta is finally here! You can now try out the new 2.3 update before the official release by switching to the 'Beta' version from the game's properties tab in your library.

The update includes new toggle bricks that trigger changes to the board when you hit them and a new plasma ball powerup that can destroy bricks from a distance. The editor also has a new play feature that lets you test boards while you build them and a new class of "Permanent" bricks that let you build walls that even fireballs, lightning and other standard powerups can't break.

Season Pass holders will also get a new sampler set of boards based on the original Classic set that will be coming with the updated Classic Pack when it's released.

There are also a lot of internal changes that are part of our ongoing efforts to modernize the game's framework, but hopefully those changes should be pretty seamless for you guys.

Please let us know if you run into any problems. You can contact us directly at help@longbowgames.com

cheers,
The Longbow Team

notes.title: Dynamic Boards and Custom Game Modes Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
A quick progress update on some of the new features we're working on:

We're really excited about a brand new scripting system that lets us create dynamic features like moving bricks, toggle buttons, and complex elements like the arcade snake in the image below. We'll be including some of these new dynamic boards in the upcoming board packs and season pass content.

We've also added custom game modes that let you adjust all of the game rules including ball speed, paddle size, active powerups, etc,. While you can still pick between difficulty levels or new vs classic rules, you can now mix and match any of the settings to find just the right mode for you.

Both of these features required some major changes to the code, so we're still finishing off some of the details, but we're hoping to have something available for beta testing in the next couple of weeks.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/c2e40e04881409fa6e5c643e50de1b5b3c0c4dd9.gif[/img]

notes.title: New DX-Ball 2 Website and Tools
notes.notes:
As things have settled down a little after the crazy rush of the holidays, we've finally had a chance to update our old [url=https://www.longbowgames.com/dxball2/]DX-Ball 2 website[/url] to reflect the new 20th Anniversary Edition.

Since you've already found us on Steam, most of the information on the site won't be new; however, if you're interested in creating new boards and other content for DX-Ball 2, the new [url=https://www.longbowgames.com/dxball2/workshop/]workshop page[/url] has a potentially helpful summary of all of the new tools you'll need.

In particular, for the first time ever we've released our tool [url=https://www.longbowgames.com/pub/texturizer]Texturizer[/url] that was used to make all of the textured bricks and backgrounds. This procedural image program was written by Seumas back in 1998, but was still in beta when he passed away and never got publicly released. We're looking forward to seeing what you guys can do with it and don't worry about the big 'Do Not Distribute' message when you open it :) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/8dd63f4c826f038e2a4db295fa756353e6bff38e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DLC and Season Pass Out Now!
notes.notes:
The first DX-Ball 2 expansion is available now! Board Pack 2 includes 150 re-mastered boards from the original game, 20 all-new anniversary boards, and more than 40 new charms and achievements.

You can get Board Pack 2 for just $2.99 US on its own or grab it as part of the Season Pass and you'll also get the next 3 board packs as soon as they're released.

And if you're still working through the boards in the main game, make sure to try out all of the new features in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1742229167183882353/]new 2.1 update[/url] including the gravity paddle, saved games, new difficulty levels and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/8d7d322946097618d921d115d2548d15e8d7e340.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.1 and DLC + Season Pass Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Version 2.1 is officialy out now with saved games, gravity push/pull, difficulty modes, scoring changes, editor improvements and more. Read all of the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1742229167183882353/]here[/url].

The re-mastered version of Board Pack 2 is almost done and will be available for sale in a few days. We'll also be releasing a DX-Ball 2 Season Pass which will get you all 4 remaining board packs for one low price, plus a Deluxe Anniversary Version for new players that includes the base game and the Season Pass.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/7bef374da598b550210c9e98a65b40518c85ae35.gif[/img]

notes.title: Testing New Update
notes.notes:
The first [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922400/discussions/0/1743353798888414300/]big update[/url] for DX-Ball 2 is now available for testing in the beta branch. This version adds a ton of requested features including saved games, gravity push/pull, new difficulty modes, scoring adjustments and volume controls.

As we wrap up this update, we're getting back to working on some new content so stay tuned for board pack announcements soon.

And for a little nostalgia, yesterday officially marked 20 years since game's launch and thanks to the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/19990427084228/http://www.longbowdigitalarts.com:80/dxball2.html]Wayback Machine[/url] you can still browse around the original page and even link through to some of the first reviews.

And for fans of the soundtrack, original DX-Ball composer Sidewinder has just published brand new versions of the game's most iconic tracks which you can stream now on [url=https://t.co/kKSArFxlzq]YouTube.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33346862/85179bb43d6f2844fe36a78b294c36fc1dd0e411.jpg[/img]
